status: frozen BEFORE any test-split simulation; run once; not changed afterwards
purpose: test-split replication of the validation C1 claim (docs/v3b/V3B_RESULTS_ZH.md, docs/v3b/C1_REFINE_RESULTS.json)
code: scripts/v3d/c1_refine.py = scripts/v3b/c1_refine.py with only split/path plumbing (--split test, --ensemble) and the addendum arm prior_top1; objective (1-IoU)+RGB_MAE_union/255 vs observed 3-view 128-frame video, deterministic compass search over log10(E/rho) [+log10(sigma_y/rho) unless jelly], step 0.5 decade halved after unsuccessful poll, bounds, nu/rho fixed, hardening/softening 0.25, nested budgets, unseen-action replay ACTIONS[(i+3)%6] vs GT replay: all unchanged. No hyperparameter changes.
failure_rule: unchanged from val: quick crash (<60 s) retried once after 75 s; still failing or mid-simulation blow-up = failed candidate with loss 9, counted in the budget, never selected; no sample dropped; GT-replay failures only drop the sample from replay IoU.

samples.rule: scripts/v3d/c1_select_test.py: logic of scripts/v3b/c1_select.py, seed 20261113, stratified by GT law x observed action over the 300 test samples, 1 per cell (18) + 12 second picks from a shuffled extra pool; selection uses only gt.json law/action

start_model.prior_top2: docs/v3d/ENSEMBLE_BCD9_TEST.json = saved 9-run V-JEPA B/C/D test predictions (runs/<run>/test_once, mean z, law posterior = vote fractions), identical to runs/v3c_ens_bcd9_test; top-2 laws by vote (tie: train-mean E/rho closest to prediction), each simulated once, search continues under the better

arms.lawmean_gt: PRIVILEGED (GT law, train mean), budget 24, replay at 12/24
arms.lawmean_best3: non-privileged (3 law means simulated, best continued), budget 24, replay at 12/24
arms.prior_top1 (ADDENDUM, requested by lead: 9-run ensemble test prediction with its top-1 law (= prior_top2 budget-0 point), no law probes, same compass search; budget 24, replay 0/4/12/24; motivated by the val finding that video-fit law probing lowered law accuracy (0.733 -> 0.617); scheduled after the three primary arms; reported in the same tables, does not affect the primary analysis

metrics: identical to val: pooled identifiable z-MAE over E/rho and sigma_y/rho (train-standardized ln1p specific, sigma_y only where defined), per-parameter MAE, law accuracy, observed-fit IoU / RGB-MAE of the selected candidate, unseen-action replay IoU, paired object-clustered bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 17) of per-sample differences at equal budgets, speedup = uninformed sims to match prior_top2+k (log-budget interpolation, object bootstrap 1000 draws, censored above 24), both budget accountings (all sims incl. probes; search-only = k minus probes), failure counts.

hypotheses_replication_criteria.H1: prior_top2 beats non-privileged lawmean_best3 at every budget: paired CI upper bound < 0 at k=0 (vs best3 at 3), 4, 12, 24
hypotheses_replication_criteria.H2: privileged lawmean_gt needs >= 6 sims to match prior_top2+0 (val: 11.7; censored >24 also counts as replicated)
hypotheses_replication_criteria.H3: prior_top2 - lawmean_gt paired CI upper bound < 0 at k=0 and k=4 (val: yes); at 12/24 val was n.s., reported descriptively

execution: docs/v3d/queue.json (ids v3d_*), scripts/r_queue.py, outputs data/v3d_refine_test/v2main_C_seed29/<idx>/<arm>/state.json; per-sample order prior_top2, lawmean_gt, lawmean_best3, then all prior_top1 jobs.
completion_rule: Analysis set = samples complete in all three primary arms at budget 24. If not all 30 are complete by 2026-11-14 18:30 UTC, the report is produced on the complete subset (in pre-registered sample order, no other selection) and labelled partial; jobs keep running and a final update on all 30 replaces it, labelled with its time. prior_top1 is reported on the analysed samples where it is complete.
no_selection_on_test: no hyperparameter, sample, arm or metric choice depends on any test outcome
